note: Fillings by the cup. Quantities scale off the finished cup, and every one says whether the proportions are somebody's published recipe or this project's own.
house_note: A filled donut takes about two tablespoons. A cup fills roughly eight, which is this project's rule of thumb and not a measurement.

sizes.label: A pint — about a dozen and a half

kinds.name: Pastry cream
kinds.region: the front row of every case
kinds.says: Thick enough to hold its shape when the donut is cut.

anchor.note: This project's own proportions, in the standard pastry-cream ratio: milk, yolks, sugar, cornflour, butter, vanilla.

steps: Heat the milk to just under a boil.
Whisk the yolks, sugar, cornflour and salt smooth. Pour a third of the hot milk in while whisking, then return it all to the pan.
Cook over medium heat, whisking, until it thickens and bubbles — about two minutes past the first bubble or it will loosen later.
Off the heat, beat in the butter and vanilla.
Press cling film onto the surface and chill it cold before it goes near a nozzle.
kinds.swap: Fold in a cup of whipped cream once it is cold and it becomes a Bavarian cream.

kinds.name: Raspberry jelly
kinds.region: the Upper Midwest, and every bakery counter
kinds.says: Seedless, thinned enough to go through a nozzle and no further.

anchor.note: This project's own proportions. The cited part is the practice: a jelly donut is filled with fruit preserve after frying.

steps: Warm the preserve with the water until it loosens.
Sharpen it with the lemon juice; shop jelly is sweeter than anything you would eat off a spoon.
Cool it to room temperature. Hot filling melts the crumb from the inside.
Fill from the side until the donut gains real weight in the hand.
kinds.swap: Powidła — stewed plum — or rose petal jam, if you are making pączki.

kinds.name: Lemon curd
kinds.region: the shops that like being asked about it
kinds.says: Sharp enough to be worth the sugar around it.
steps: Whisk the eggs, sugar and juice in a pan off the heat.
Cook gently, stirring, until it coats a spoon. Do not boil it.
Off the heat, beat in the butter a piece at a time, then the zest.
Sieve it, then chill it. It thickens as it cools.

kinds.name: Whipped cream filling
kinds.region: the shops that fill to order
kinds.says: Light, fast, and gone by lunchtime.

anchor.note: This project's own proportions. Stabilised with a little powdered sugar's starch, which is why it is not plain cream.

steps: Whip the cream cold, with the bowl cold, to soft peaks.
Beat in the sugar and vanilla and take it to firm peaks — no further, or it turns.
Fill the same morning. This one does not hold overnight.
